title: LIVE WELL, NOT JUST LONG
openLoop: The richest place on earth isn't a bank

recap.title: How to live a life that counts
items: God preserves you to finish your assignment
It's God — not statistics — who numbers your days
Not the years in your life, but the life in your years
Live well — it's never too late or too early
Don't just begin well — finish well

scriptures.text: Teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

scenes.point: God preserves your life so you can finish your assignment
scenes.teaser: Who decides how long you live?

scenes.point: Not statistics — God alone numbers your days
scenes.teaser: One man refused to die first

scenes.point: Caleb at 85: 'I'm as strong as ever — give me this mountain'
scenes.teaser: It's not the years that count

scenes.point: The goal isn't to live long — it's to live well
Paul met God in his 30s and poured out for 35 years
scenes.teaser: It's never too late — or too early

scenes.point: Abraham 75 · Moses 80 · Paul 35 · Samuel 12 — your stage doesn't matter
scenes.teaser: How do you want to be remembered?

scenes.point: God's desire isn't that you begin well — but that you finish well
